no_cap.why: the natural default without the chat: each rider pays their full share, however big, with no 9.26 cap

free_under_5_km.why: guesses a round 5 km for the free station hop instead of 4175 metres

free_up_to_4175.why: off by one: a ride of exactly 4175 metres is free too, though only shorter ones are

thursday.why: a look-alike day: money is due on the first Thursday after the ride instead of the first Tuesday
